Today's Daily Battle — locale Bible NOTICE
==========================================

English on this site is the King James Version (public domain in the United States).
Language homes look up the same official UTC reference from the files below.
We flattened each text to a {"Book C:V": "text"} map for lookup. That is an
adaptation, not a new translation.

Reina-Valera 1909 (Spanish)
  License: public domain
  Via: eBible.org (spaRV1909) and HelloAO (spa_r09)
  File: es-rv1909.json
  Adaptation: leading "Salmo." headings stripped from some verses.

Louis Segond 1910 (French)
  License: public domain
  Via: eBible.org / HelloAO (fra_lsg)
  File: fr-lsg1910.json
  Adaptation: leading "Psaume." headings stripped from some verses.

Almeida 1911 (Portuguese)
  License: public domain text (João Ferreira de Almeida tradition;
           1911 reprint of a 1900 edition)
  Via: getBible.net https://api.getbible.net/v2/almeida.json
  File: pt-almeida1911.json

Chinese Union Version 1919, simplified (和合本)
  License: public domain
  Via: eBible.org (cmn-cu89s) and HelloAO (cmn_cu1)
  File: zh-cuv.json

Russian Synodal Bible, 1876 (Синодальный перевод)
  License: public domain
  Via: eBible.org (russyn) and HelloAO (rus_syn)
  File: ru-synodal.json
  Adaptation: psalm chapter numbers follow the Septuagint; lookup maps
              KJV psalm numbers onto this edition so the day's verse matches.

Hindi Indian Revised Version (IRV) 2019
  Copyright © 2017, 2018, 2019 Bridge Connectivity Solutions
  https://bridgeconn.com/
  License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International
           https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
  Via: eBible.org (hin2017) and HelloAO (HINIRV)
  File: hi-irv.json
  Adaptation: flattened to a verse map; trailing study-note parentheses
              that were not verse wording were removed.
  ShareAlike: this flattened file remains under CC BY-SA 4.0. Keep this
              copyright notice, the license, and this adaptation note.

Indonesian
  No public-domain Indonesian full Bible is stored yet. Indonesian pages
  that quote Scripture use the King James Version (public domain in the
  United States). Terjemahan Baru is not stored and must not be quoted.

Not hosted
  NIV, ESV, NLT, NKJV, NASB, Reina-Valera 1960, NVI, Segond 1978/NEG,
  Terjemahan Baru, and other copyrighted modern editions.

Distributors
  eBible.org — https://ebible.org/
  HelloAO Free Use Bible API — https://bible.helloao.org/
  getBible.net — https://getbible.net/
  aruljohn/Bible-kjv (English KJV vendor source) —
    https://github.com/aruljohn/Bible-kjv
